downloadQualityPrompt.appliesToThisDownloadOnly: This applies only to the download you are starting now.

settings.acceptedLanguagesHelp: An ordered preference list — first is most preferred. Used by the naming mode below to decide when to keep an original-language name.
settings.acceptedLanguagesEmpty: No languages added — original-language names are never preferred.
settings.askQualityBeforeManual: Ask for quality before manual downloads
settings.askQualityBeforeManualHelp: Keep the default quality for automatic downloads, but choose per album, song, or playlist when starting downloads yourself.
settings.stagingInsideLibrary: Store temp staging inside music library
settings.namingConventionHelpPre: Controls how track and album folder names are written.
settings.namingConventionHelpPost: strips featured-artist tags and trailing “– Single” suffixes to match Qobuz/Octo Fiesta naming.
settings.showOtherVersionOptions: Show other version options on album pages
settings.showOtherVersionOptionsHelp: For albums already in the library, offer pills to download the album again in the formats selected below. Each version is stored in its own folder.
settings.enableAutoDownloadsHelp: Pause background checks for followed artists and playlists without changing what you follow.
settings.autoIntervalAuto_one: Currently ≈ every {{label}} across {{count}} followed artist and playlist. Adjusts automatically to keep Apple Music API calls under the daily safety budget.
settings.autoIntervalAuto_other: Currently ≈ every {{label}} across {{count}} followed artists and playlists. Adjusts automatically to keep Apple Music API calls under the daily safety budget.
settings.autoIntervalManual: Each artist and playlist is checked at most once every {{label}}.
settings.libraryTagsDescription: Adds ISRC and barcode tags to untagged FLACs so music you already have is recognized.
settings.scanLibraryForMissingTags: Scan your library for missing tags?
settings.phaseSigningIn: Signing in to Apple Music — this can take up to 90 seconds
settings.phaseReady: Signed in successfully. Ready to download.
settings.signInOnTrustedDevice: Sign in once with the new password on a trusted Apple device so Apple trusts the account again.
settings.waitThenClear: Wait a few minutes, then come back here, click {{clear}}, and enter the new credentials.
settings.lockoutWarning: Retrying without doing the above will only deepen the lockout — this is Apple's anti-abuse protection, not a bug here.
settings.noAppleCredsStored: No credentials stored. Enter your Apple ID used for Apple Music.
settings.twoFactorCodeHelp: Apple sent a 6-digit code to your trusted devices. If you only see Allow / Not Me, generate a code from Settings → Apple ID → Sign-In & Security → Get Verification Code.
settings.enterSixDigitCode: Enter the 6-digit code Apple showed on your trusted device
settings.mediaTokenHelpPre: Required for lyrics. In your browser open
settings.mediaTokenHelpPost: , play any song, then in the web inspector storage tab open the cookies for music.apple.com and double-click the value of the media-user-token row to copy the full string, it's long and opaque
settings.enableNavidromeScanHelp: Triggers a Subsonic API scan immediately after a successful download.
settings.noNavidromeCredsStored: No credentials stored. Enter your Navidrome admin credentials.
settings.signedOutOnAllOtherDevices: Signed out on all other devices.
settings.usernameBadChars: Username can use letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
settings.usernameTooShort: Username must be at least {{min}} characters.
settings.usernameTooLong: Username must be no more than {{max}} characters.
settings.pickDifferentUsername: Pick a different username to update.
settings.copyBlocked: Copy blocked by the browser, click Show token and copy it by hand
settings.newTokenRegenerated: New token, update AppleMusic__ApiToken in octo-fiesta
settings.octoFiestaDescription: is a Subsonic proxy for Navidrome that adds streaming catalogues to your music apps. With this on, it shows Apple Music in their search and downloads through alacarte when you play or star something.
settings.octoFiestaSetupHint: Set these in octo-fiesta (use an alacarte address octo-fiesta can reach). Both must mount the same music folder.
settings.lyricsBackfillDescription: Fetches lyrics for tracks without a lyrics file. Needs a media-user-token.
settings.scanLibraryForMissingLyrics: Scan your library for tracks without lyrics?
settings.artistBackfillDescription: Tags each artist and composer separately so media servers don't show "A & B" as one artist.
settings.scanLibraryForArtistCredits: Rewrite artist credits across your library?
settings.namingModeOriginalIfAcceptedHelp: Original names when their language is in your accepted list.
settings.namingModeDualHelp: Display name with the original added, e.g. Bubbles (泡沫).
settings.appleStatusProbing: Testing whether Apple accepts requests again…
settings.appleStatusCooldown: Apple is rate limiting this server. Requests resume in about {{time}}.
settings.appleQueued: Waiting: {{interactive}} from the app, {{batch}} from downloads and integrations, {{background}} in the background
settings.appleRateLimited24h_one: Rate limited {{count}} time in the last 24 hours
settings.appleRateLimited24h_other: Rate limited {{count}} times in the last 24 hours
settings.appleLearnedFloor: After being rate limited the app will not go faster than one request every {{seconds}} s.
settings.appleStatusHelp: All requests to Apple Music share one limiter. Clicks in the app go first, downloads and integrations next, background work only uses what is left.
settings.appleAdaptiveLabel: Speed up automatically from the starting gap while Apple keeps answering, and slow down after a rate limit
settings.appleSettingsHelp: A shorter gap is faster but makes it more likely that Apple rate limits this server for 15 to 60 minutes. Every rate limit doubles the pause.

artist.trackScopeForFutureReleases: Track {{scope}} for future releases, with the option to download matching releases now.
artist.chooseWhatToWatch: Choose what this follow should watch and download.
artist.appliesIfDownloadDiscographyNow: Applies if you download the current discography now.
artist.stopWatchingConfirm: Stop watching for new releases? Your existing downloads stay in the library.

playlist.unfollowedBanner: Playlist unfollowed. Your existing downloads stay in the library.
playlist.followedBanner: Playlist followed. New tracks will download automatically.
playlist.title: Title
playlist.followModalDescription: alacarte will watch this playlist and automatically download tracks you add to it. Removing a track from the playlist keeps its download in your library.
playlist.appliesIfDownloadNow: Applies if you download the existing tracks now.
playlist.unfollowModalDescription: Stop watching for new tracks? Your existing downloads stay in the library.

authScreen.usernameCharsHint: Username can use letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
authScreen.setupTokenRequiredHint: Setup token is required for first-time setup.
authScreen.pickUsernamePasswordHint: Pick a username and a password (min {{min}} chars).
authScreen.tooManyAttemptsWait: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
authScreen.changeLaterHint: You can change this later from Settings → Account.

selectDownloadsModal.appliesToEveryAlbum: Applies to every selected album in this queue.

healthPill.stalledRecoveredTitle: Download wrapper stalled and was auto-recovered.
healthPill.stalledTitle: The download wrapper has produced no output for a while; the download is stopped if it does not recover.
healthPill.wrapperOfflineTitle: Apple Music wrapper is offline — add credentials in Settings.
healthPill.appleTokenTitle: Could not fetch the public Apple Music bearer token.
healthPill.musicFolderTitle: Music output folder is not writable.
healthPill.leaseLostTitle: Apple Music is playing on another device with this account. The wrapper resumes in about {{mins}} min, or right away when a download starts.
healthPill.wrapperRestartingTitle: The Apple Music wrapper is starting up.

home.title: Good listening
home.abortConfirmBody: This cancels every queued and running download. Completed history is kept.

library.deleteAlbumBody: This removes all tracks and lyrics in this album folder for {{artist}}.
library.deleteSongBody: This removes the song file and its lyrics sidecar from your library.
library.deletePlaylistBody: This removes the .m3u8 file and any audio folder under Playlists/{{name}}/ via the library API.

queue.pausedNotice: Queue paused. The current download finishes, nothing new starts until you resume.

cloudLibrary.emptyBody: Save some {{kind}} in Apple Music and they'll show up here.
cloudLibrary.confirmDescription: Queues every {{kind}} in your Apple Music library{{itemsNote}}. Items already in your local library are skipped automatically.
cloudLibrary.downloadQualityHint: Applies to every item queued by this action.
cloudLibrary.tokenRejectedBody: Apple rejected the saved token. Refresh it in Settings — it expires periodically.
cloudLibrary.probeFailedBody: Network or token error while probing the Apple Music library.
cloudLibrary.connectAccountBody: To list your saved library here, paste your media-user-token in Settings. Without it, alacarte can only fetch the public catalog.

following.errorCheckNewMusic: Failed to check for new music
following.title: Following
following.subtitle: Follow artists to watch for new releases and playlists to auto-download tracks you add to them.
following.emptyArtistsBody: Open an artist page and use Follow to start watching for new albums and singles.
following.emptyPlaylistsBody: Open one of your Apple Music playlists (or any Apple playlist) and use Follow. alacarte will download every track you add to it.

search.searchPlaceholder: Artists, albums, songs, playlists, or Apple Music links…
search.emptyStateHint: Try searching for an artist, album, or song — or paste an Apple Music link.

status.title: Status
status.wrapperOfflineHint: Offline. Re-authenticate in Settings to bring the wrapper back.
